posts.title: The Shoebox Mindset
posts.description: Shoeboxes, Zettelkasten slip boxes, and Danish butter cookie tins everyone expects to hold sewing supplies. How I use a $40 ThinkPad X200T running AntiX, which is decade-old hardware, as my daily driver, and why the concept of e-waste baffles me. posts.title: An Open Apology to Householder Karl
posts.description: An open apology to Householder Karl for a rude email I had no right to write, and an examination of the hateful guestbook entries that both preceded and followed his publishing our exchange—a pattern of anonymous harassment I've been documenting for months.

posts.title: I Want It Darker
posts.description: Winter is closing in, the number of exploited security vulnerabilities is doubling, and I've built an emergency USB stick and an offline library in case the Internet goes down. On asceticism and benign masochism, Hesse's 'love your suffering,' tools as extensions of the body, and why preparedness, voluntary hardship, and routine are all ways of tricking ourselves into thinking we have control.
